quiz.title: Class 12 Maths Chapter-wise Quiz
quiz.intro: Eight questions spanning the Class 12 syllabus, one from each major chapter. Choose an answer for each, then press Check my score and read the working for anything you miss.

questions.q: A relation R on a set is called an equivalence relation when it is:
questions.explanation: An equivalence relation must satisfy all three properties at once: reflexive, symmetric and transitive. Miss any one and it is not an equivalence relation.

questions.q: The principal value of sin−¹(1/2) is:
questions.explanation: sin−¹ returns an angle in [−π/2, π/2]. Since sin(π/6) = 1/2, the principal value is π/6.

questions.q: If A is a 3×3 matrix with |A| = 4, then |2A| equals:
questions.explanation: For an n×n matrix, |kA| = kⁿ|A|. Here n = 3, so |2A| = 2³ × 4 = 8 × 4 = 32.

questions.q: The function f(x) = |x| is continuous but not differentiable at:
questions.explanation: |x| has a sharp corner at x = 0, where the left and right derivatives differ (−1 and +1), so it is continuous there but not differentiable.
The integral of 1/x is the natural logarithm of |x|: ∫ 1/x dx = ln|x| + C. The modulus keeps it valid for negative x too.

questions.q: The order of the differential equation d²y/dx² + 3(dy/dx)³ + y = 0 is:
questions.explanation: Order is the highest derivative present. The highest here is d²y/dx², so the order is 2. The cube is only the degree of dy/dx, not the order.

questions.q: The dot product of two perpendicular non-zero vectors is:
questions.explanation: a·b = |a||b|cosθ. For perpendicular vectors θ = 90° and cos 90° = 0, so the dot product is 0.

questions.q: Two events A and B are independent when:
questions.explanation: Independence means one event does not affect the other, so the probability of both occurring is the product: P(A∩B) = P(A)·P(B).

faq.q: Which chapters does a Class 12 Maths chapter-wise assignment cover?
faq.a: It runs across the full CBSE syllabus: relations and functions, inverse trigonometric functions, matrices and determinants, continuity and differentiability, applications of derivatives, integrals, differential equations, vectors and three-dimensional geometry, linear programming and probability.

faq.q: How should I use chapter-wise assignments in my revision?
faq.a: Finish a chapter, then attempt only that chapter's assignment while the theory is fresh. This isolates weak spots faster than a mixed paper, and you can return to full-syllabus practice once each chapter is solid.

faq.q: Which Class 12 chapters carry the most marks in the board exam?
faq.a: Calculus is the heaviest block — continuity, differentiability, applications of derivatives, integrals and differential equations together account for the largest share. Vectors and 3D geometry, and algebra (matrices and determinants) follow.

faq.q: Are these assignment questions enough for the board exam?
faq.a: They build the routine practice you need chapter by chapter, but pair them with previous-year board papers and at least a few full-length timed mock tests so you get used to the exam's spread and time pressure.
